AusPost: Your parcel is held at our depot. Pay the $2.99 redelivery fee at https://auspost-parcel-fee.xyz/pay within 12 hours or it will be returned.
Findings Brief
Evidence
History
DI
Verdict: Likely scam
High risk
This matches the parcel delivery or unpaid toll text scam that Scamwatch (ACCC) warns about. Don't open the link or pay anything through it.
Key findings
•
It says a parcel, delivery or toll has a problem: “parcel is held”.
•
It asks you to pay a fee or update your details: “Pay the $2”.
•
auspost-parcel-fee.xyz carries AusPost's name, but it isn't AusPost's domain (auspost.com.au) — the name has other words added to it.
What isn't certain
•
Apollo can't confirm who actually sent this — a pattern match supports the assessment but isn't proof about the sender.
What you can do
•
Don't open the link or pay anything through it.
•
Check your delivery or toll account through the company's official app or a website address you type yourself.
•
Report it to Scamwatch at scamwatch.gov.au. If you've already paid or entered card details, contact your bank now.
